verdict.rationale: Granola documents private-by-default notes: they are never shared unless you share the link or add the note to a team-space folder. It also documents a split between a private 'My notes' space and a workspace team space, plus copy-link sharing. However, team-space folders are simply visible to everyone in the workspace, and nothing shows granular per-link or per-folder permission levels or admin oversight of shared content. Missing for 10: granular link/folder/workspace permission controls (e.g. access levels, restricting link audiences), admin visibility or audit of what's shared, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared

citations.quote: Your notes are never shared with any participants unless you share the link, or add the note to a folder in your team space.
Copy link will copy a unique URL link to the meeting notes, which you can send to others.
The Granola sidebar is organized into two spaces: My notes — Your private space... [Your workspace name] — Your team space.
Folders here are visible to everyone in your workspace.
